name: Makera Z1 Pro
notes: EU store pre-order price for the Z1 Pro Standalone (regular €1,599; Makera announces an MSRP increase of €200 from 1 Oct 2026); current batch ships from the factory in 5-10 business days. Same chassis as the Z1, but NEMA 17 closed-loop steppers (detect overload/position deviation and halt) and ball screws instead of Acme lead screws; image shows the shared Z1 chassis. Weight 17 kg per spec table (quick-start guide: ~20 kg net). Accuracy = stated resolution 0.02 mm; repeatability 0.002 mm per vendor FAQ (Z1 family). Custom quick-change collet (1/8" standard). Wired Z probe included; the included 3D probe rod works on conductive stock only. Optional 4th axis (Ø80 × 150 mm) and 5 W laser.

accessories.name: Makera Z1 4th Axis Module
accessories.description: Belt-driven rotary module for the Z1 (Ø80 × 150 mm) for cylindrical and multi-sided parts.

accessories.name: Makera Z1 Laser Module
accessories.description: 5 W 445 nm diode laser head that installs like a milling bit, for engraving.

accessories.name: Makera 3D Wired Probe
accessories.description: 3D touch probe for edge, centre and surface finding on metal and non-metal workpieces.

accessories.name: Makera Cyclone Dust Collector Lite
accessories.description: Compact cyclone dust collector with automated machine control; the recommended extractor for the Z1.

accessories.name: Makera Cyclone Dust Collector
accessories.description: Full-size cyclone dust collector with automated control for long, continuous milling jobs.

accessories.name: Makera Z1 Vacuum Bed
accessories.description: Vacuum workholding bed for flat stock; requires a Makera Cyclone Dust Collector (Standard or Lite).

accessories.name: Makera Z1 Low-Profile Vise
accessories.description: Low-profile side-clamping vise that keeps the top surface free and raises stock for through-cuts.
